text: The Hag Queen's whispers have done their work. Call in every debt, every secret, every stolen kiss, and make this faction a loyal [[img:icon_vassal]][[/img]]vassal of Naggaroth. The target faction must have reached 100% [[img:icon_seductive_influence]][[/img]]seductive influence. The total [[img:icon_seductive_influence]][[/img]]seductive influence required to reach this threshold depends on the target's race and number of settlements.

In the Dark Convent, Morathi shapes the next generation of Sorceresses and Supreme Sorceresses, each trained along the path the Hag Queen chooses for her. From her court she also weaves dark magic and seduction across the world, sending her Sorceresses to carry out her rituals.
